name: Kikomando
methodRaw: Chop the chapati, fry with beans and onion.

name: Pumpkin porridge
methodRaw: Boil and mash pumpkin, stir into millet porridge.

name: Smoked fish in groundnut sauce
methodRaw: Soak fish, simmer in groundnut sauce 20 minutes.

name: Chapati pizza
ingredientsRaw: Chapati, tomato paste, cheese, green pepper
methodRaw: Top chapati and grill until the cheese melts.

name: Pancakes with passion fruit
ingredientsRaw: Wheat flour, eggs, milk, passion fruit
methodRaw: Make thin pancakes, pour passion pulp over.

name: Nsenene (grasshopper) fry
methodRaw: Pluck, wash and dry fry until crisp.
